subject: Thorin

subject: Thorin

source_quote: Daz shouts, 'You have a point. They probably fell into the water.'

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir wonders how Thorin managed to stay alive all of these years.
source_quote: The dragonborn sighs. He wonders how Thorin managed to stay alive all of these years.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir wonders if he will survive next to Thorin, Daz, and Grygum.
source_quote: In fact he’s beginning to wonder if he will survive next to Thorin, Daz, and Grygum.

subject: Zalthir

source_quote: “We could check to see if there is any blood or gore on the boat?”

source_quote: He then looks at the castaways they collected and asks, 'Do any of you recognize the boat?'

subject: Duergar
fact: The duergar says, 'Yes, it’s Duergar Keelboat. You can see the crates.'
source_quote: The duergar looks at it and says, 'Yes, it’s Duergar Keelboat. You can see the crates.'

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin asks, 'Are they big enough to hold people? I am worried about an ambush.'
source_quote: Thorin suddenly wises up, 'Are they big enough to hold people? I am worried about an ambush.'

subject: Hemeth
fact: Hemeth says, 'Yes, that would be a good thing to worry about. The Duergar can become invisible for a whole hour.'
source_quote: Hemeth laughs, 'Yes, that would be a good thing to worry about. The Duergar can become invisible for a whole hour.'

subject: Hemeth
fact: Hemeth turns invisible and says, 'I will be hiding here.'
source_quote: And he turns invisible. 'I will be hiding here.'

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin asks, 'Can’t we do something to detect them, like splash water?'
source_quote: Thorin, who, to Zalthir’s pleasant surprise, is becoming a lot more paranoid, asks, 'Can’t we do something to detect them, like splash water?'

subject: Daz
fact: Daz says, 'I have shape water!'
source_quote: I have shape water!'

subject: Daz
fact: Daz sprays water around the boat and the outline of a humanoid appears.
source_quote: And a few moments later, water is sprayed around the boat, and the outline of a humanoid appears.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir groans inwardly because Daz will be excited.
source_quote: Zalthir groans inwardly because Daz will be excited.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is annoyed because they were about to have the element of surprise.
source_quote: Zalthir is annoyed. They were about to have the element of surprise.

source_quote: He invokes Darkness and plunges into the water to attack the foe.

fact: Zalthir’s initial strike misses, but the second strikes home with a thud.
source_quote: The Dragonborn’s initial strike misses, but the second strikes home with a thud.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin senses another creature in the water and is tempted to use a handheld crossbow, but he rejects the idea.
source_quote: Thorin can sense another creature in the water and is tempted to use a handheld crossbow, but he rejects the idea.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin dives into the water, swims next to Zalthir, and strikes the invisible creature, wounding it.
source_quote: Diving into the water, he swims next to Zalthir and strikes the invisible creature, wounding it.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin hears two scorching rays hit the water and hiss harmlessly.
source_quote: Thorin hears two scorching rays hit the water and hiss harmlessly.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin hears the scream of a Duergar in pain.
source_quote: He’s about to lose hope when he hears the scream of a Duergar in pain.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin thinks the creature is still alive.
source_quote: Thorin thinks the creature is still alive.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin hears Grygum's magical words and the telltale sound of a belch.
source_quote: Then he hears Grygum's magical words and the telltale sound of a belch.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin hears a scream and someone from the boat being grappled and pulled overboard.
source_quote: Then he hears a scream. He can hear someone from the boat being grappled and pulled overboard.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin hears two more members of the crew being grappled.
source_quote: Two more members of the crew are grappled.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar shouts, 'You know what the Duergar do for a living?'
source_quote: Jimjar shouts, 'You know what the Duergar do for a living?'

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin wonders why the gnome would want to talk about anthropology now.
source_quote: Thorin wonders why the gnome would want to talk about anthropology now

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar says, 'Yes, they capture slaves that they sell in Gracklstugh.'
source_quote: “Yes, they capture slaves that they sell in Gracklstugh.”

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir shouts, 'At least it’s where we were going.'
source_quote: Thorin overhears Zalthir shout, 'At least it’s where we were going.'

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin notices that Eldeth is not one of those captured.
source_quote: Thorin approaches the boat and notices that Eldeth is not one of those captured.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin sighs, relieved.
source_quote: He sighs, relieved.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin sees that Stool has been captured.
source_quote: The dwarf checks the others and sees that Stool has been captured.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin attacks the Duergar and the Duergar release Stool.
source_quote: He attacks the Duergar. And the Duergar release Stool.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir’s fists strike the creature that had Spiderbait, killing it.
source_quote: His fists strike the creature that had Spiderbait, killing it.

subject: Daz

source_quote: Daz shouts, 'Leave one uncovered!'

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir shouts, 'It protects you!'
source_quote: Zalthir shouts, 'It protects you!'

subject: Daz
fact: Daz’s magic bolts kill the other creature.
source_quote: The burst of magic bolts kills the other creature.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum belches and another Duergar dies covered in acid.
source_quote: Another belch sounds, and another Duergar dies covered in acid.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is tired and happy after the last Duergar is immobilized.
source_quote: A few moments later, the last of the Duergar is immobilized, and Zalthir is tired and happy.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir finds some gold and a jug that can generate any liquid.
source_quote: He finds some gold and a jug that he learns later can be used to generate any liquid.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir generates mayonnaise as the first liquid.
source_quote: The first liquid they generate is mayonnaise.

subject: Buppido

source_quote: Buppido shouts, 'I have particular expertise and talents.'

subject: Sarith

source_quote: Sarith explains, 'The Lolth’s guards trained me. I am an expert, but having seen Daz’s approach, I recommend that he be given the first crack at extracting information.'

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum thinks there might be some rivalry between the Duergar gods and the Dwarven gods.
source_quote: The orc has been puzzled by Eldeth’s venom directed at the Duergar. He thinks there might be some rivalry between the Duergar gods and the Dwarven gods...

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum remembers that religious conflict is not always what it seems.
source_quote: ...but then he remembers something he read: that religious conflict is not always what it seems.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum mutters, 'This is not the will of any god. This is the will of the people.'
source_quote: “This is not the will of any god. This is the will of the people,” he mutters.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz remembers that the long journey through the dark waters of the Underdark has led him to the metropolis of the Duergar.
source_quote: The long journey through the dark waters of the Underdark has led him here to the metropolis of the Duergar in this part of the Underdark.

subject: Hemeth
fact: Hemeth says his home is a strictly regimented, xenophobic city.
source_quote: Over the past few days, Hemeth has said a lot about his home, which sounds unpleasant. It’s a strictly regimented, xenophobic city.

subject: Hemeth
fact: Hemeth says non-Duergars are only permitted to move freely in the Darklake district.
source_quote: Non-Duergars are only permitted to move freely in the Darklake district.

subject: Hemeth
fact: Hemeth says the Duergar can become invisible at will.
source_quote: The Duergar can become invisible at will; you never know who is watching.

subject: Hemeth
fact: Hemeth says it’s a city of slavers.
source_quote: And finally, it’s a city of slavers.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is unprepared for how plain and functional the Duergar city is.
source_quote: Daz is unprepared for what he sees. The city is so unlike the Drow cities Daz has heard of.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz notes the Duergar prize order and work over art and beauty.
source_quote: The Duergar prize order and work over art and beauty.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz observes the walls of Duergar homes are plain.
source_quote: The walls of the Duergar homes are plain.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz notes the ambiance is that of work, with hammers, heat, and smelters.
source_quote: The sound of hammers warping metals, the stench and heat, and the light of the smelters make all of Gracklstugh appear as one large work camp.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz remembers the acrid smoke makes breathing hard and burns his sense of smell.
source_quote: But the acrid smoke makes breathing hard and burns through his sense of smell, which he will remember most from his time here.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar whispers, 'Buy equipment so we can survive more easily. Get information on how to get out of the Underdark.'
source_quote: Jimjar whispers, 'Buy equipment so we can survive more easily. Get information on how to get out of the Underdark.'

subject: Sethir
fact: Sethir mutters, 'We plan to get equipment and then go to the Lost Tomb of Khem, where we will find treasure!'
source_quote: Sethir mutters, 'We plan to get equipment and then go to the Lost Tomb of Khem, where we will find treasure!'

subject: Daz
fact: Daz remembers Hemeth’s description of the Blade Bazaar.
source_quote: Daz remembers what Hemeth had said about the Blade Bazaar:

subject: Daz
fact: Daz says out loud, 'To the Blade Bazaar.'
source_quote: “To the Blade Bazaar,” he says out loud.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin asks, 'What are we going to do about them?' referring to Brannum and Buppido.
source_quote: Thorin remembers some castaways. He looks at Brannum Redmarch and Buppido and says, 'What are we going to do about them?'

subject: Brannum
fact: Brannum pleads, 'You wouldn’t turn me into the guard?'
source_quote: Brannum pleads, 'You wouldn’t turn me into the guard?'

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir asks, 'Could you purchase some uncommon magical items?'
source_quote: Zalthir asks, 'Could you purchase some uncommon magical items?'

subject: Brannam
fact: Brannam lights up, 'Why didn’t you ask? That’s my business.'
source_quote: Brannam lights up, 'Why didn’t you ask? That’s my business.'

subject: Hemeth
fact: Hemeth grumbles, 'I am a weapons trader, and you would go to him?'
source_quote: Hemeth, upon hearing that, grumbles, 'I am a weapons trader, and you would go to him?'

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir asks, 'Can either of you get me Eldritch Claw Tattoo?'
source_quote: Zalthir asks them, 'Can either of you get me Eldritch Claw Tattoo?'

subject: Hemeth
fact: Hemeth shrugs, 'No.'
source_quote: Hemeth shrugs, 'No.'

subject: Brannam
fact: Brannam lights up, 'Yes! I know a guy. But it will take a few days. And then the slate is wiped clean?'
source_quote: Brannam lights up, 'Yes! I know a guy. But it will take a few days. And then the slate is wiped clean?'

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin says, 'And just so we are clear, if we don’t get what we want, and you betray us, there will be consequences.'
source_quote: Thorin realizes that Zalthir is very good at negotiating a deal, but sometimes muscle is needed to terrorize people, 'And just so we are clear, if we don’t get what we want, and you betray us, there will be consequences.'

subject: Brannam
fact: Brannam shrinks, 'Yes, of course.'
source_quote: Brannam shrinks, 'Yes, of course.'

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido mutters, 'Look, I made mistakes. It was the divine plan. Just let me go. I won’t bother you again.'
source_quote: Buppido mutters, 'Look, I made mistakes. It was the divine plan. Just let me go. I won’t bother you again.'

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is tempted to kill Buppido but wants to see what everyone else has to say.
source_quote: Spiderbait, still seething with rage, wants to kill him on the spot, and although Thorin is tempted, he wants to see what everyone else has to say.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir says, 'Perhaps he will betray us.'
source_quote: Zalthir is unsure. 'Perhaps he will betray us.'

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin pulls his sword and asks, 'So we kill him?'
source_quote: That logic sways Thorin and pulls his sword. 'So we kill him?'

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum says, 'There are so many people who will kill us that I am not so sure we should worry about him.'
source_quote: Grygum intervenes, 'There are so many people who will kill us that I am not so sure we should worry about him.'

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin lowers his weapon, uncertain.
source_quote: Thorin lowers his weapon, uncertain.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz says, 'I vote that we get as close to a guarantee as we can and then, as we leave, let him loose in the city.'
source_quote: Daz says, 'I vote that we get as close to a guarantee as we can and then, as we leave, let him loose in the city.'

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido pleads, 'I made mistakes. I was mad. The divine plan called me, and I realized it was a mistake. I have learned from Shuushar that I was mad. PLEASE!'
source_quote: Buppido is desperate and pleads, 'I made mistakes. I was mad. The divine plan called me, and I realized it was a mistake. I have learned from Shuushar that I was mad. PLEASE!'

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir hands Buppido the Mushroom of Madness and says, 'Eat.'
source_quote: Then Zalthir hands him a mushroom, The Tongue of Madness, and says, 'Eat.'

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido eats and says, 'I just wanted to return to my bolt hole in the caverns near the city and praise the Divine Plan.'
source_quote: And Buppido does and starts talking. 'I just wanted to return to my bolt hole in the caverns near the city and praise the Divine Plan.'

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido says, 'You all have been so annoying. Daz has foul-smelling breath. Thorin thinks his muscles are impressive. Eldeth is -not- interested in him.'
source_quote: And then he starts expressing his true opinions of his companions: 'You all have been so annoying. Daz has foul-smelling breath. Thorin thinks his muscles are impressive. Eldeth is -not- interested in him.'

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum says, 'Zalthir’s scales haven’t been cleaned in ages.'
source_quote: Grygum has heard enough, 'Zalthir’s scales haven’t been cleaned in ages.'

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum says, 'Jimjar’s bEttin g is so annoying! GIVE IT A REST.'
source_quote: But then he says, 'Jimjar’s bEttin g is so annoying! GIVE IT A REST.'

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir smiles, 'I like him.'
source_quote: Zalthir smiles, 'I like him.'

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin tells Jimjar, 'You all need to keep an eye on him.'
source_quote: Thorin turns to Jimjar - 'You all need to keep an eye on him.'

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar smiles, 'Wanna bet?'
source_quote: Jimjar smiles, 'Wanna bet?'

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir asks, 'So - wait, I mean, can he summon Demogorgon like the Kuo-toans?'
source_quote: But just then, Zalthir remembers something, 'So - wait, I mean, can he summon Demogorgon like the Kuo-toans?'

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar roars with laughter.
source_quote: Jimjar roars with laughter.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar says, 'Obviously, you do not understand the first thing about interplanar or gate travel.'
source_quote: Jimjar then sighs and stares at Grygum, 'The Cult of the Dragon almost brought Tiamat into the realms, and that required artifacts and rituals. No, Buppido has no such powers. But, Zalthir, it does beg the question - who did?'

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum asks Dulgir, 'Sell this mace?'
source_quote: The cleric of Bahamut approaches a stall in the Blade Bazaar and tries to engage a merchant in a deal. The merchant, Dulgir, asks if he wants to buy or sell. 'Sell this mace?'

subject: Dulgir
fact: Dulgir curses Grygum, accusing him of things that might provoke a violent reaction.
source_quote: At that, the Duergar starts cursing Grygum, accusing him of things that, in a different sEttin g, might have provoked a violent reaction.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum decides to start by buying, and Dulgir shifts, speaking with the stilted tongue of a Baldurian patriar.
source_quote: Grygum pauses and decides that he should start by buying, and the Duergar suddenly shifts, speaking with the stilted tongue of a Baldurian patriar.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum becomes the proud owner of a new mace.
source_quote: A few minutes later, he is the proud owner of a new mace.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir shows Grygum a list of names and says, 'I found this list of names earlier.'
source_quote: As he toys with his mace, he notices Zalthir looking at a list. 'I found this list of names earlier.'

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum says, 'I think they might be worth looking into.'
source_quote: Grygum shrugs. 'I think they might be worth looking into.'

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir mutters, 'They could be people who could help us.'
source_quote: Zalthir is annoyed that he has nothing more definitive to say and mutters, 'They could be people who could help us.'

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum notices many duergar merchants give different prices depending on the buyer.
source_quote: Grygum then notices that Dulgir is not the only one acting strangely. Many duergar merchants give different prices to buy or sell the same items whenever they are asked and insist that the buyers they deal with change their terms.

subject: Merchant
fact: A merchant turns invisible during a transaction but keeps speaking as if nothing has happened.
source_quote: Near a food stall, a merchant suddenly turns invisible during a transaction but keeps speaking as if nothing has happened.

subject: Merchant
fact: A weapons merchant threatens a customer and denies ever saying so.
source_quote: Across the aisle, another weapons merchant threatens a customer, and when the customer protests, the merchant denies ever saying so.

subject: Cloth Merchant
fact: A cloth merchant stops mid-negotiation and talks to someone he calls his brother.
source_quote: Next to him, a cloth merchant suddenly stops mid-negotiating and starts talking to someone he refers to as his brother.

subject: Customer
fact: A customer asks, 'Who is he talking to?'
source_quote: When the customer asks who he is talking to,

subject: Merchant
fact: The merchant says, 'My brother!'
source_quote: the merchant says, 'My brother!'

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum asks Dulgir, 'I guess his brother is invisible.'
source_quote: Grygum asks Dulgir, 'I guess his brother is invisible.'

subject: Dulgir
fact: Dulgir answers, 'His brother doesn’t exist.'
source_quote: But Dulgiar answers, 'His brother doesn’t exist.'

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is disturbed and convinced some madness afflicts the city.
source_quote: The answer disturbs Grygum, who is convinced that some madness afflicts the city, perhaps the same madness that consumed the Kuotoans.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum sees a two-headed, gray-skinned giant burst through a gate, howling madly.
source_quote: And just then, the rhythmic hammering of the city’s forges is drowned for a second by a thundering roar and the sound of crumbling rock. Duergar and visitors alike turn to look as a two-headed, gray-skinned giant burst through a gate, howling madly and lashing out left and right...

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum sees a duergar soldier’s broken body fly through the air and crash with a sickening crunch.
source_quote: ...whose broken body flies through the air and crashes near you with a sickening crunch.
